note: Scripture is Louis Segond 1910 (fra_lsg, the ebible mirror). Brother Lawrence quotes almost no verse as a verse; the echoes (Mark 9:23, Galatians 1:10, Ephesians 6:5-6, Matthew 7:7…) are rendered in his own words and recorded as self_rendered.

The work was written in French (de Beaufort’s Conversations, 1692; the Letters, 1694). This edition is translated from the Revell English translation that the English edition reproduces, not reconstructed from the 17th-century French; a reviewer may wish to compare well-known sayings with the original. Lawrence addresses God as vous, as classical French prayer does. AI-translated (job #6252); awaiting native review.
